business_problem: To support the always-on nature of digital finance, Banqsoft relies on Microsoft SQL Server as its data platform. Currently, the company uses SQL Server 2017 and 2019, Azure SQL Database, and Azure Storage, which gives it a flexible hybrid environment that meets data location requirements. “We use SQL Server for everything, from onboarding our customers to bank transactions to source recovery,” said Magnus Zetterberg, Technical Fellow at Banqsoft.
solution_summary: Banqsoft is a Nordic-based market leader offering software solutions for asset finance, digital banking, and credit management. Combining cutting-edge technology with industry expertise, the company helps its customers stay competitive in an increasingly digital financial landscape. Banqsoft’s proprietary software solutions cover a broad range of Fintech use cases, including car loans, leasing services, hire purchase, payment protection, consumer loans, and credit and debit cards, debt collection, ledger and invoicing services. Nearly all Banqsoft products are built on the same IT platform, using an open, flexible architecture that increases efficiency and makes it easy for customers to add new products or expand market reach. The implementation centers on SQL Server 2022, Azure SQL Database, Azure Storage, Azure Synapse Link for SQL.
business_outcome: Banqsoft is a Nordic-based market leader offering software solutions for asset finance, digital banking, and credit management. Combining cutting-edge technology with industry expertise, the company helps its customers stay competitive in an increasingly digital financial landscape.
metrics: “We simulated our workload in SQL Server 2022 and saw performance jump by 18 to 20 percent. It looked almost too good, so we ran the test again and saw the same increase in speed. It’s very impressive.”
